name: Sheba
overview: Sheba is a male figure identified in Scripture as the son of Joktan, as recorded in Genesis 10:28. Beyond this unique attribute, there is no additional tribal affiliation or other distinguishing notes provided in the biblical text.
namesAndTitles: The name Sheba is a proper name meaning 'oath' or 'seven.' This meaning is derived from the original Hebrew and is noted in Genesis 10:28. There is no indication that the name was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Sheba as the son of Joktan, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family relationships or tribal affiliations are mentioned in the biblical text beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Sheba's significance in the biblical narrative is tied primarily to his genealogical placement as a descendant of Joktan. This connection situates him within the broader context of the post-Flood genealogies, which trace the origins of various peoples. While the text does not elaborate on his personal deeds or role, his mention helps affirm the fulfillment of God's command to multiply and fill the earth.
